description: This file defines the CanvasScheme enum, which includes static methods and constants related to URL schemes and MIME types for handling web resources within the application.

classes.name: CanvasScheme
classes.description: An enum containing constants and methods related to URL schemes and MIME types for web resources.

methods.name: makeURL(session:path:)
methods.description: Constructs and returns a URL object based on the session and optional path parameters.

methods.name: mimeType(forExtension:)
methods.description: Returns the MIME type string corresponding to a given file extension.
